Pentagon Restructures Under Pete Hegseth's Leadership

Pete Hegseth has announced significant changes within the Pentagon, including the creation of an Office of Religious Affairs that reports directly to him. He also unveiled a new Autonomous Warfare Command focused on military drone technology. In addition, Hegseth stated that 20% of generals will be cut. These announcements were made during his State of the Force address.
